checks.name: Full rack matching purchase upgrades in place with one debit and no seventh slot
Nonmatching full rack swap charges exact net price only on explicit selection
Swap is affordable from resale, cancellation is free, insufficient net funds never mutate
Fully locked rerolls reject without cost and capped vouchers reject without cost
An active extra shelf is never offered again as a run rule
Pending replacement blocks next wave, cancellation permits it, reroll clears stale selection
